notes: Approximate snapshot. Fees are the adult non-resident price, rounded to whole SGD.
Food places: cost is a typical meal per person, not an admission fee.
One opening window per place per day, no day-of-week logic. Shows list their daily showtimes; Spectra's extra 22:00 Fri/Sat show is left out.
checked=yes: values cross-checked against web sources on curated_on. checked=no: still to verify against source_url.
close = 24:00 means open until midnight or later; single-day trips end by midnight.
